title: The Brave Little Tailor
summary: A little tailor sat on his bench sewing when seven flies landed on his jam bread. Slapping with a cloth, he killed all seven at once!...
keywords: the brave little tailor (das tapfere schneiderlein)
full_text:
A little tailor sat on his bench sewing when seven flies landed on his jam bread. Slapping with a cloth, he killed all seven at once!

"What a hero I am!" he cried. He embroidered a belt with gold letters: "Seven at One Blow!" and set out to conquer the world.

Meeting an enormous giant on the mountain, the tailor challenged him. When the giant crushed a rock in his fist, the tailor squeezed a lump of soft cheese until water dripped from his hand! When the giant threw a stone high into the clouds, the tailor tossed a live bird into the air that flew away over the peaks! The giant, thinking it was a stone that never returned, was terrified.

The king promised the tailor his daughter's hand and half his kingdom if he could vanquish two wild giants, a fierce unicorn, and a rampaging wild boar.

The brave little tailor tricked the two giants into fighting each other by dropping stones on their heads while they slept; he trapped the unicorn by making it drive its horn into an oak tree; and he lured the boar into an abandoned church and locked the door!

The astonished king had to keep his royal oath, and the little tailor married the princess and became a wise, victorious king, proving that intellect and audacity conquer every giant.
moral: Audacity, quick wit, and presence of mind conquer giants where brute force fails.

Believing rumors and flattery without proof
